item.name: Cat Lady
item.appearance: Girl with black hair and a cropped tee.
item.request: Wants her missing black cat back from your parents' bedroom.
item.anomalySigns: Before you open up, check the parents' bedroom. A white cat next to the bed means she is lying about a black cat.
item.safeSigns: A black cat is waiting next to the bed, matching her story.
item.bestAction: Open the door and return the black cat if it matches. Turn the porch light off if the cat is white.
item.cardSummary: House check first. Black cat by the bed is safe; white cat means reject with the porch light.

item.name: Firefighter
item.appearance: Tall man in full firefighter gear.
item.request: Claims smoke is coming from your oven and needs to put the fire out.
item.anomalySigns: Check the oven. No smoke means the firefighter story is fake.
item.safeSigns: Smoke is actually coming from the oven, matching the claim.
item.bestAction: Open the door if the oven is smoking. Turn the porch light off if there is no smoke.
item.cardSummary: Always verify the oven before you trust a firefighter at the door.

item.name: Plumber
item.appearance: Man with a moustache in a black shirt, carrying a red toolbox.
item.request: Says he was called to fix a leaky bath faucet.
item.anomalySigns: Check the bath faucet. If nothing is leaking, he is an Anomaly.
item.safeSigns: The bath faucet is leaking water, matching the repair story.
item.bestAction: Open the door if the faucet is leaking. Turn the porch light off if it is dry.
item.cardSummary: Confirm the leaky bath faucet before you let the plumber in.

item.name: City Maintenance
item.appearance: Man in overalls and a hard hat.
item.request: Claims the water has turned brown and needs to fix it.
item.anomalySigns: Run the sink. No water at all means he is an Anomaly.
item.safeSigns: Running water comes out brown, matching his warning.
item.bestAction: Open the door if the sink water is brown. Turn the porch light off if nothing comes out.
item.cardSummary: Sink check decides this one: brown water is real, no water is fake.

item.name: Dumped Girl
item.appearance: Crying woman in a black jacket and camo pants.
item.request: Asks for tissues to wipe her tears.
item.anomalySigns: On the laptop cameras she is smiling and staring straight at you instead of crying.
item.safeSigns: Camera view still shows her crying normally without the fake smile stare.
item.bestAction: Turn the porch light off if the camera shows a smile and stare. Open the door if she still looks upset on cam.
item.cardSummary: Camera check for a false smile and direct stare before you trust the crying act.

item.name: Ballerina
item.appearance: Blonde girl in a ballerina outfit.
item.request: Wants to dance for you.
item.anomalySigns: Laptop cameras show her dancing on the doorstep.
item.safeSigns: On camera she is standing still and normal on the porch.
item.bestAction: Turn the porch light off if she is dancing on cam. Open the door if she is standing normally.
item.cardSummary: Use the door camera: dancing on the porch means Anomaly, standing still is safe.

item.name: Homeless Man
item.appearance: Man with scraggly hair and a long coat.
item.request: Asks you for food.
item.anomalySigns: He does not appear on the laptop cameras at all.
item.safeSigns: He is visible on the cameras like a normal visitor.
item.bestAction: Turn the porch light off if he is missing from the cams. Open the door if he shows up on camera.
item.cardSummary: If the door visitor is invisible on the laptop cameras, reject him.

item.name: Dog Owner
item.appearance: Man in a black polo shirt.
item.request: Wants to collect his dog from your backyard.
item.anomalySigns: Backyard camera shows the dog owner hunched on all fours and barking instead of a dog.
item.safeSigns: Backyard camera shows a dog sitting there, matching his request.
item.bestAction: Turn the porch light off if the owner is the one barking in the yard. Open the door if a real dog is on the backyard cam.
item.cardSummary: Check the backyard camera before you believe the dog story.

item.name: Wifi Kid
item.appearance: Kid in a red hoodie holding a tablet.
item.request: Wants the wifi password.
item.anomalySigns: Opening the cameras triggers a glitchy shutter-click noise repeating over the feed.
item.safeSigns: Camera audio stays normal with no shutter glitch loop.
item.bestAction: Turn the porch light off if the camera audio glitches. Open the door if the feed sounds normal.
item.cardSummary: Listen for camera shutter glitches when this kid is at the door.

item.name: Obby Player
item.appearance: Bald middle-aged man in a black shirt.
item.request: Wants to play Roblox with you.
item.anomalySigns: The camera on your mum's car shows him smashing the car with his fist.
item.safeSigns: The mum's-car camera view looks normal with no attack on the vehicle.
item.bestAction: Turn the porch light off if he is wrecking the car on cam. Open the door if that camera stays normal.
item.cardSummary: Switch to the car camera. Fist-smashing the car means Anomaly.

item.name: New Neighbour
item.appearance: Very tall man in a shirt and tie.
item.request: Introduces himself as your new neighbour and wants to meet you.
item.anomalySigns: On night vision his face is pressed up against the camera screen.
item.safeSigns: Night vision still shows a normal stance with no face pressed into the lens.
item.bestAction: Turn the porch light off if night vision shows a face on the screen. Open the door if he stays normal.
item.cardSummary: Toggle night vision. A face mashed into the camera means reject.

item.name: Guy Who Needs To Pee
item.appearance: Man in a hoodie clutching his stomach.
item.request: Needs to use your bathroom.
item.anomalySigns: Night vision makes him look noticeably taller than the normal camera view.
item.safeSigns: Night vision height matches the regular camera view.
item.bestAction: Turn the porch light off if night vision stretches him taller. Open the door if his size stays consistent.
item.cardSummary: Compare normal cam to night vision. A sudden height jump is the Anomaly tell.

item.name: Secret Agent
item.appearance: Man in a full suit and sunglasses.
item.request: Wants to warn you about an alien threat in the neighbourhood.
item.anomalySigns: Night vision turns him into a roughly 7-foot alien.
item.safeSigns: Night vision still shows a suited man, not an alien form.
item.bestAction: Turn the porch light off if night vision shows an alien. Open the door if he stays human on night vision.
item.cardSummary: Night vision is the whole test: alien form means Anomaly.

item.name: Lost Girl
item.appearance: Little girl with long hair and a grey jacket.
item.request: Asks to use your phone.
item.anomalySigns: Night vision shows her as giant compared with the normal camera view.
item.safeSigns: She looks the same size on normal cameras and night vision.
item.bestAction: Turn the porch light off if night vision makes her giant. Open the door if both views match.
item.cardSummary: If night vision turns a small visitor huge, keep the porch light off.

item.name: Sleepy Woman
item.appearance: Girl in a pink jumper and grey sweats.
item.request: Wants to lie down in your bed for a short rest.
item.anomalySigns: On night vision her head snaps forward unnaturally.
item.safeSigns: Night vision does not change her head pose or posture.
item.bestAction: Turn the porch light off if her head snaps on night vision. Open the door if nothing changes.
item.cardSummary: Watch the night-vision feed for a sudden head snap before you decide.

item.name: Classmate
item.appearance: Child with red hair, glasses, and a chequered shirt.
item.request: Wants to work on homework together.
item.anomalySigns: Voice flips between a normal kid tone and a gravelly demonic voice.
item.safeSigns: Voice stays a consistent normal tone the whole conversation.
item.bestAction: Turn the porch light off if the voice turns demonic. Open the door if the tone stays steady.
item.cardSummary: Listen through the whole line. A demonic voice swap means Anomaly.

item.name: Party Girl
item.appearance: Dancing girl in a tank top and baggy jeans.
item.request: Invites you to a party.
item.anomalySigns: Her voice echoes in a melodic, unnatural way.
item.safeSigns: She speaks in a normal, non-echoing voice.
item.bestAction: Turn the porch light off if the voice echoes melodically. Open the door if she sounds normal.
item.cardSummary: A melodic echo on her voice is the reject signal.

item.name: Gym Bro
item.appearance: Large muscular man in a white shirt.
item.request: Needs water for a protein shake.
item.anomalySigns: Voice is extremely high-pitched instead of matching his build.
item.safeSigns: Voice sounds normal for the character.
item.bestAction: Turn the porch light off if the voice is high-pitched. Open the door if he sounds normal.
item.cardSummary: Trust your ears: an ultra-high voice on a huge gym visitor is the Anomaly.

item.name: Police Man
item.appearance: Tall man in a police uniform.
item.request: Wants to come inside to check for a roaming criminal.
item.anomalySigns: A beat-up van is parked in front of the house instead of a police car.
item.safeSigns: A police car is parked out front, matching a real officer visit.
item.bestAction: Turn the porch light off if you see a beat-up van. Open the door if a police car is parked outside.
item.cardSummary: Look outside first: police car is safe, beat-up van is Anomaly.

item.name: Streamer
item.appearance: Child in a video-game shirt, Adidas trackies, and very shiny white crocs.
item.request: Wants to feature you on a livestream.
item.anomalySigns: No phone in hand while claiming to stream.
item.safeSigns: Holding up a giant phone, matching the livestream setup.
item.bestAction: Turn the porch light off if there is no phone. Open the door if the giant phone is out.
item.cardSummary: Check the hands. Giant phone is real streamer energy; empty hands mean Anomaly.

item.name: Vampire
item.appearance: Tall pale man with a flared collar.
item.request: Asks to be invited inside.
item.anomalySigns: No confirmed safe form is documented. Treat any vampire invitation as an Anomaly.
item.bestAction: Turn the porch light off. Do not invite the vampire inside.
item.cardSummary: No documented safe version. Keep the porch light off and refuse the invitation.

item.name: Goblin Stalker
item.appearance: Small pale-skinned demon goblin that can appear around the house.
item.request: Jumpscares you inside the house. Not a door visitor.
item.anomalySigns: A permanent house jumpscare figure that can appear while you move around.
item.bestAction: Ignore it. It cannot harm you.
item.cardSummary: House scare only. Spooky, not deadly—keep working the door checks and chores.
